mission: Wire ack_protocol and vector_clock into critical message paths

tasks.title: Wire ack into help_protocol.py
tasks.notes: Found already wired by prior team. Verified: ack_protocol param in __init__, send_no_wait in request_help/offer_help/fulfill_help, check_unacked_requests method present. Backwards compatible (ack_protocol defaults to None).

tasks.title: Wire vector clocks into work_stealing.py pipelines
changes: Added optional vector_clock parameter to PipelineManager.__init__
Added _stage_vectors dict to track per-stage vector clock snapshots
start_stage(): accepts incoming_vector_clock param, merges it before processing, attaches vc to bus notification
complete_stage(): ticks vector clock on completion, attaches vc snapshot to bus notification
trigger_downstream(): attaches completed stage's vector clock to stage-ready notifications for downstream consumption
Added verify_ordering() method that checks pipeline stage vector clocks respect causal dependencies
Full backwards compatibility: all new params optional, no behavior change when vector_clock=None

tasks.title: Wire ack into coordinator_hub.py instructions
changes: Added optional ack_protocol parameter to CoordinatorDashboard.__init__
Added _CRITICAL_INSTRUCTION_TYPES class constant: redirect, reassign, shutdown
send_instruction(): uses ack_protocol.send_no_wait for critical instruction types, falls back to plain bus on failure
broadcast_instruction(): uses ack_protocol.send_no_wait per-agent for critical instruction types, falls back to plain bus on failure
Added get_unacknowledged_instructions() method: queries ack_protocol.get_unacked filtered to instruction msg_type
AgentReporter.check_instructions(): auto-acks received instructions via ack_protocol when available
Full backwards compatibility: all new params optional, no behavior change when ack_protocol=None

integration_notes.usage_example_vc: pipeline_mgr = PipelineManager(db_path, bus_dir, team, agent_id, vector_clock=vc_instance)
